problem: The calibration date came round and nobody told him
action: Daytime. The dealer is crouched down on one knee beside a dispenser unit on the island, close in to its lower housing, examining a small sealing wire and lead seal on the panel with his fingers. He has his reading glasses on. His other hand rests on his knee. He is inspecting something he clearly does not inspect often.
lighting: Bright but slightly overcast daylight, soft-edged shadows under the canopy, cool grey concrete, the white dispenser body bouncing light up into his face.
camera: Low, close, from the side — his head and shoulders in the upper half of the vertical frame and the dispenser housing and his hand in the lower half. Sharp on his hand and face. 35mm.
detail: The dispenser body is plain white with NO branding, NO logos, NO product names, NO numbers, NO display readouts, NO lettering. Any screen is dark. Same cream full-sleeve shirt with the sleeves rolled, same dark navy trousers, same watch.
feeling: Checking something late. The sinking feeling of realising a date has already gone by.
motion: He turns the small seal slightly between finger and thumb, then goes still. A slow push in. Nothing else moves, no cuts, no camera shake, nobody speaks.

voice_over.hi: नापतौल का कैलिब्रेशन इसी महीने था। किसी ने बताया ही नहीं।
